name: norse_lineup
title: The Norse culture (D-149): the vikings' lines through the ages, and the Norse on every body
_doc: Rows 1-4: 'vikings' (humans) line by line at ages 1 to 3 (fur cap, conical cap or horns, spectacle helm; bearded axe at age 2, broad axe at age 3), the rune healer, the berserker, the Raven-Feeder hero. Rows after: the Norse swordsman at age 3 on the other bodies that pass placement (spiders and beetles wait for their shield hand: backlog §0b).
